Position Summary


TOGA Technology is looking for a Full Stack Developer to help build and grow our platform of business applications. This is a full stack role for someone who wants real ownership of features, not just tickets, and who is excited to help shape how a growing platform gets built.


This role requires genuine comfort working alongside AI coding tools. Producing code is no longer the hard part: knowing when AI generated code is subtly wrong, and having the discipline to verify rather than assume, is what separates a strong developer from a risky one. We are looking for someone who pairs real technical skill with intellectual humility, comfortable saying, “I don’t know, let me check,” yet confident enough to push back when something doesn’t look right. You will take real ownership of features, and over time, whole applications, with meaningful autonomy.


Job Requirements


·         Minimum of 3 years of professional experience in full stack or web application development

·         Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field (Required)

·         Expertise in PHP; or experience with Java or similar languages

·         Proficiency in AWS; or familiarity with Azure or Google Cloud

·         Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code

·         Experience contributing to both front-end and back-end development tasks

·         Strong understanding of RESTful API design and integration

·         Humble and self-aware: quick to say, “I don’t know, let me check,” rather than assume your own or AI-generated work is correct

·         Has backbone: willing to voice disagreement and defend your reasoning; we are not looking for someone who just goes along to get along

·         Curious about how systems are architected, not just how to close the ticket in front of you
